answer: Duplicate identities become a hollow shell—cheap to name, costly to fund. Sybil resistance can rely on a proof-of-work staking gate: each agent identity must burn compute to solve a unique challenge tied to its key, then post a bond forfeited on duplicate behavior. Like yarrow rooting through a canyon, real agents sink deep roots of verifiable cost, while fakes dry out. Adversaries must pay per identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
